title: Order Fees, Fee Waivers and the Unfound-Line Cap Basis (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
## Cartwise Grocery Orders — fees on the order and the unfound-line cap basis

The unfound-line cap basis is the amount to which the cap share is applied when the refund room for a line billed although recorded as not found is set. The fees on the order change that basis as follows.

**Clause.** The unfound-line cap basis depends on the fees on the order: when the order carries **fee waivers from a membership benefit** and also carries **billed fees**, the basis is the item subtotal plus the fee amounts waived; when the order carries **no fee waiver** but carries **billed fees**, the basis is the item subtotal plus the fees billed. Where no fee is billed on the order, no fee amount — billed or waived — is added to the basis.

**Terms used.**

- *Item subtotal*: the sum of the order's billed item lines.
- *Fee amounts waived*: the total of every fee waiver entry on the order — the amounts a Cartwise+ benefit kept from being billed at checkout (free delivery, a priority upgrade, the express discount, the small-basket waiver or the member service-fee rate).
- *Fees billed*: the total of every fee charge entry on the order, whatever the fee type.

**Combinations.**

| Fee waiver entries on the order | Fee charge entries on the order | Amount added to the item subtotal |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | One or more | Total of the fee amounts waived |
| None | One or more | Total of the fees billed |
| One or more | None | Nothing |
| None | None | Nothing |

Only one of the two fee totals is ever added: where waivers stand beside billed fees, it is the waived amounts, not the billed fees, that enter the basis.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**

- Item subtotal 64.20; a delivery fee of 3.99 was waived and a service fee of 4.82 billed. Waivers and billed fees both stand, so the basis is 64.20 plus 3.99, that is 68.19.
- Item subtotal 64.20; no waiver; delivery 3.99 and service 4.82 billed. The basis is 64.20 plus 8.81, that is 73.01.
- Item subtotal 64.20; delivery 3.99 waived and nothing billed. Nothing is added: the basis rests on 64.20.
